'''Slithering Strangler''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Slithering Strangler}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Constrict
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 3 {{BD2|Constrict}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Constrict
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Thwack
|Intent = Attack2, Defend
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage. Gains 5 {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Lash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc2|9|13}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always opens with {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Constrict}}. After that, it randomly picks {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Thwack}} or {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Lash}} (equal chance, can repeat). After either attack, it always uses {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Constrict}} again, then returns to the random pick.

The pattern is: 
* {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Constrict}}
* 50/50 chance to use {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Lash}} or {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Thwack}}
* {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Constrict}}
* 50/50 chance to use {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Lash}} or {{Int2|Slithering Strangler|Thwack}}

{{Clear}}
